statements.status_notes: Debian trixie and upstream gdk-pixbuf 2.44.6 still lack a released fix for heap out-of-bounds reads in ICNS RLE decompression (https://security-tracker.debian.org/tracker/CVE-2026-18090, https://gitlab.gnome.org/GNOME/gdk-pixbuf/-/issues/308). The DHI rebuild adds source-length bounds checks to uncompress() and guards the it32 payload skip per the upstream issue analysis.

Marked no-dsa by Debian Security Team; see https://security-tracker.debian.org/tracker/CVE-2026-18090

Debian trixie ships jpeg-Be-more-careful-with-chunked-icc-data.patch (upstream commit 4af78023 for CVE-2025-7345), which introduced the ICC profile free-on-error path without clearing size metadata. The DHI rebuild backports upstream commit efe658674bd103d1c9bf50809d5767a3f6dd5a01 (MR 278), which clears icc_profile_size and icc_profile_size_allocated after that free. See https://security-tracker.debian.org/tracker/CVE-2026-81893.
